board.description: a saved filter over the tasks — membership is never stored

query.description: the filter that IS the board; the empty query selects nothing

filed.description: optional portfolio filing, separate from being a task

priority.description: queue order — lower is more urgent

project.description: what it is filed under; deleting the project frees the task rather than taking it along

assignee.description: whose queue this task is filed in

domain.description: the work area this task is filed in

repository.description: the @yaks/git repository this project's work is in — its checkouts are `worktree`s of it

base_branch.description: what work branches from and lands into

gate.description: the command a change must pass before it lands

repo.description: a project's landing policy for its source: which repository it is in, what work branches from, and how a change is proven and published

phase.description: where it is: a phase, not a status — nothing here is done. Suspension is `paused`, so a phase never has to be remembered and put back

tagline.description: one line saying what it is

site.description: where it lives on the web

venture.description: a business being built: the phase it is in and where it lives. Who runs it is an edge, and the model an agent uses is @yaks/model's

at.description: when work on it was suspended

paused.description: work on it is suspended — a mark, so the phase underneath is untouched and resuming removes the mark
